ridge:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent terrain sprite for Monster Mash, an anime isekai overhead desert action game.
Primary request: a compact straight ridge of dark basalt boulders with pale dusty highlights. The entire solid silhouette is a narrow horizontal capsule, about 3:1 wide to deep. Angular crisp anime painted stone detail; readable when displayed 440 by 160 game units. Camera steep overhead, nearly top down, consistent with a desert battlefield. Only the solid stones, with tiny crevice cracks. The rocks fill their footprint: NO crescent enclosing a flat floor, NO sandy ledge, NO plateau, NO ground, NO plants, NO ground skirt, NO cast shadow extending outside the rocks. Transparent background everywhere outside solid rock. Centered with 8 percent transparent padding on all sides, completely uncut silhouette. No text, no border, no UI. High resolution, sharp edges.
